name: Azpieuskalki model improvement via Nafarroa town CSV fix

description: Add 53 Nafarroa towns to CSV + fix hyphen normalization + disable validation filter → 10 classes, 37K sentences, acc 51.02% (was 49.76% on 410 samples). ipar-goi-nafarrera now has 5.8K sentences (was 18). hego-goi-nafarrera still 0 — towns not scraped yet.

asi.hypothesis: Fixing Nafarroa town CSV gap and hyphen matching would unlock new data for azpieuskalki training
asi.result: ipar-goi-nafarrera grew from 18 to 5842 sentences. Overall acc went 49.76% → 51.02% but test set grew 13x. hego-goi-nafarrera still 0 samples — towns are in CSV but were never scraped.
asi.next: Scrape high-value Nafarroa towns (>50 passages) to get hego-goi-nafarrera data; then investigate sartaldekoa/sartaldeko-naf-lap confusion
